exposure: Iatrogenic grade 3A perineal tear after mediolateral episiotomy during spontaneous vaginal delivery
cohort: The cohort consisted of patients who had iatrogenic grade 3A perineal tears during normal vaginal delivery after episiotomy and for whom general surgery consultation was requested between May 2017 and December 2017.
finding: Postoperative day 1 showed reduced sphincter tone which improved but remained lower than normal on day 7, with 42.8% of patients experiencing gas incontinence but no fecal incontinence.
mod_finding: The study's findings describe the outcomes of grade 3A perineal tears following episiotomy during spontaneous vaginal delivery, including reduced sphincter tone and gas incontinence.
